name: lsp
title: Language servers
description: Diagnostics, hover, completion, signature help, definitions, references, rename, formatting, symbols and semantic tokens from a language server per language (clangd, pyright, typescript-language-server).
note: Built into Forge: forge.screen.json includes lsp.json, and its natives (Lsp.cpp, LspProtocol.cpp) are compiled in, so this manifest names and versions the package and lists no provides; it is not in the catalogue. main.cpp grants the servers it finds on PATH; a language without one works as before.
